label: Add the setting that asks to confirm a punishment when the member has a recent case
summary: Adds column "confirm_recent_minutes" to "GuildModeration" when it does not have it

execute.description: add the column, 0 (never asking) for the guilds that are there
execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."GuildModeration" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "confirm_recent_minutes" int4 NOT NULL DEFAULT 0

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'GuildModeration' AND column_name = 'confirm_recent_minutes') AS "result"
